items.name: S 마운트
items.reason: S마운트의 비대칭 다리 배치는 보이지만 파랑이 흰 상완을 잡는 팔의 가로 전완이 흰 소매로 이어져, 같은 수비자 팔의 소속이 섞입니다.
keyChecks: The two white legs have an asymmetric S arrangement

items.regenerationGuidanceEnglish: Keep the asymmetric S-mount legs and the current camera. Trace the blue defender arm from its blue upper-arm sleeve through its bent elbow to the hand touching the white upper arm. The horizontal forearm crossing the white chest must remain BLUE, not white. Keep only the two white controller arms at the wrist and upper-arm controls. Do not add an extra arm to solve the overlap; keep the naturally hidden white arm portions occluded.

items.regenerationGuidanceEnglish: Depict a representative static truck control from behind and beside the blue hips. Clearly trace the white leg entanglement collecting the same blue leg and show the white hand controlling the other blue ankle or lower leg, rather than only holding the belt. Use a three-quarter hip-side view that exposes the two defining contacts without forcing all limbs into view. Keep both necks neutral and do not replace the control with a twister finish.
